answer: The most effective way to remember names is to force yourself to repeat the name several times in the same sentence. For example, tell yourself, “Her name is Linda Linda Linda because the line of her forehead is Linda.” Writing it down is unnecessary once you start repeating it, and trying to associate the name with something familiar only slows you down. Just repeat the name several times and you will be sure to recall it later.
